source: PHP Ledger 1.4.5, owner review of 26 September 2026 (docs/design/setup-1.4.5/legal_forms.py)
note: Wording and guidance only. Every form maps to a canonical family that pl_legal_forms() knows; nothing here activates a tax rule. ZZ is the neutral list for any other country.

sole_proprietor.money_out: drawings; what you put in is your capital

partnership.money_out: partner drawings and the year-end profit split

llp.money_out: partner drawings by the agreed ratio

single_member_company.money_out: salary or dividends, tracked in the share ledger

private_limited.money_out: salary or dividends, tracked in the share ledger

public_limited.money_out: dividends, tracked in the share ledger

corporation.money_out: salary or dividends, tracked in the share ledger

non_profit.owners: members or trustees, nobody owns it
non_profit.money_out: nothing: surplus stays in the organisation

other.owners: set once you choose a form
other.money_out: set once you choose a form

forms.name: Sole proprietorship
forms.short: One owner and no separate company. Registered with FBR for an NTN; nothing is filed with SECP.
forms.numbers: NTN, and STRN if registered for sales tax

forms.name: Partnership firm (AOP)
forms.short: 2 to 20 partners under the Partnership Act 1932; taxed as an association of persons.
forms.numbers: the firm's NTN, and STRN if registered

forms.name: Limited liability partnership (LLP)
forms.short: Partners with limited liability under the LLP Act 2017.

forms.name: Single member company — (SMC-Private) Limited
forms.short: A private company with one shareholder under the Companies Act 2017.

forms.name: Private limited company — (Private) Limited
forms.short: 2 to 50 shareholders; shares are never offered to the public. The usual company.

forms.name: Public limited company — Limited (listed or unlisted)
forms.short: Shares may be offered to the public; a listed company also answers to the PSX.

forms.name: Section 42 company, trust or society
forms.short: Not for profit. Section 42 companies are licensed by SECP; trusts and societies by the provincial registrar.

forms.name: Other or not sure
forms.short: Pick the closest form; your registration papers or your accountant will say. It can be changed later in Company profile.

forms.name: Sole trader
forms.short: One person trading. Registered with HMRC for Self Assessment, not at Companies House.
forms.numbers: UTR, and VAT number if registered

forms.name: Partnership
forms.short: Two or more people trading together; the partnership and each partner register with HMRC.
forms.numbers: the partnership UTR, and VAT number if registered

forms.name: Limited liability partnership (LLP)
forms.short: Members with limited liability; incorporated at Companies House.

forms.name: Private company limited by shares (Ltd)
forms.short: The usual small company: shareholders own it, directors run it. One shareholder is fine.

forms.name: Public limited company (PLC)
forms.short: Shares may be offered to the public; at least £50,000 of share capital.

forms.name: Community interest company limited by shares (CIC)
forms.short: A limited company for a social purpose: shareholders, an asset lock and a dividend cap. The CIC Regulator sits alongside Companies House.
forms.registrar: Companies House and the CIC Regulator
forms.numbers: company number, UTR, VAT number if registered

forms.name: Company limited by guarantee, CIC limited by guarantee, or charity (CIO)
forms.short: No shareholders; members guarantee a nominal sum. CICs and charities have their own regulator too.
forms.registrar: Companies House or the Charity Commission
forms.numbers: company or charity number, VAT number if registered

forms.name: Other or not sure
forms.short: Pick the closest form; your registration papers or your accountant will say. It can be changed later in Company profile.

US.name: United States
US.registrar: the Secretary of State of the state of formation

forms.name: Sole proprietorship
forms.short: You and the business are one for tax. A DBA name may be filed with the state or county.
forms.registrar: no registrar; the IRS issues an EIN if you need one

forms.name: General partnership
forms.short: Two or more owners. The partnership files a return; the partners pay the tax.
forms.registrar: the state, if it requires it

forms.name: Limited liability partnership (LLP)
forms.short: A partnership registered with the state whose partners have limited liability; common for professional firms.

forms.name: Limited liability company (LLC)
forms.short: The usual small-business form; owners are members. Taxed as a sole proprietorship, partnership or corporation by election.

forms.name: Corporation (C corp or S corp)
forms.short: Shareholders own it and a board runs it. S corp is a tax election, not a different registration.

forms.name: Nonprofit corporation (501(c)(3))
forms.short: A state nonprofit corporation; the IRS tax exemption is applied for separately.

forms.name: Other or not sure
forms.short: Pick the closest form; your formation papers or your CPA will say. It can be changed later in Company profile.

AE.name: United Arab Emirates
AE.registrar: the economic department of the emirate (in Dubai, the Department of Economy and Tourism) or the free zone authority

forms.name: Sole establishment
forms.short: Owned by one person who is fully liable; licensed by the economic department of the emirate.
forms.registrar: the economic department of your emirate (DET in Dubai)
forms.numbers: trade licence number, and TRN if registered

forms.name: Civil company (professional partnership)
forms.short: Partners practising a profession together, with unlimited liability.
forms.registrar: the economic department of your emirate (DET in Dubai)

forms.name: Limited liability company (LLC, mainland)
forms.short: The usual mainland company; one or more shareholders with limited liability.
forms.registrar: the economic department of your emirate (DET in Dubai)

forms.name: Free zone establishment (FZE)
forms.short: A free zone company with a single shareholder.
forms.registrar: the free zone authority (DMCC, JAFZA, DIFC, ADGM…)

forms.name: Free zone company (FZCO or FZ-LLC)
forms.short: A free zone company with one or more shareholders; the name depends on the free zone.

forms.name: Private joint stock company (PrJSC)
forms.short: Shares held privately; two or more founders and higher capital than an LLC.
forms.registrar: the Ministry of Economy and the economic department of the emirate

forms.name: Public joint stock company (PJSC)
forms.short: Shares offered to the public and usually listed.

forms.name: Association or non-profit
forms.short: Licensed by the Ministry of Community Development or the emirate; no owners.

forms.name: Other, branch of a foreign company, or not sure
forms.short: Pick the closest form; your licence will say. It can be changed later in Company profile.

IN.name: India
IN.registrar: the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (Registrar of Companies)

forms.name: Sole proprietorship
forms.short: No separate registration; the owner's PAN is the business PAN. GST and Udyam registration as needed.

forms.name: Partnership firm
forms.short: Under the Indian Partnership Act 1932; registered with the state Registrar of Firms.

forms.name: Limited liability partnership (LLP)
forms.short: Under the LLP Act 2008; incorporated with the MCA.

forms.name: One person company (OPC)
forms.short: A private company with a single member under the Companies Act 2013.

forms.name: Private limited company (Pvt Ltd)
forms.short: 2 to 200 members; the usual company for a startup or family business.

forms.name: Public limited company (Ltd)
forms.short: Shares may be offered to the public; seven or more members.

forms.name: Section 8 company, trust or society
forms.short: Not for profit. Section 8 companies are licensed by the MCA; trusts and societies by the state.
forms.registrar: the MCA or the state registrar

forms.name: Other or not sure
forms.short: Pick the closest form; your registration papers or your CA will say. It can be changed later in Company profile.

forms.name: Sole proprietorship
forms.short: One owner registered with ACRA; the registration is renewed for one or three years.
forms.numbers: UEN, and GST number if registered

forms.name: Partnership or limited partnership (LP)
forms.short: A general partnership has 2 to 20 partners; a limited partnership has no cap. Both register with ACRA.
forms.numbers: UEN, and GST number if registered

forms.name: Limited liability partnership (LLP)
forms.short: Partners with limited liability; a separate legal entity.

forms.name: Private company limited by shares (Pte. Ltd.)
forms.short: The usual company, up to 50 shareholders. With 20 or fewer, none corporate, it is an exempt private company.

forms.name: Public company limited by shares (Ltd.)
forms.short: Shares may be offered to the public.

forms.name: Company limited by guarantee, society or charity
forms.short: Not for profit; a charity registers with the Commissioner of Charities as well.
forms.registrar: ACRA or the Registry of Societies

forms.name: Other or not sure
forms.short: Pick the closest form; your ACRA profile will say. It can be changed later in Company profile.

forms.name: Sole proprietor (FIE)
forms.short: Füüsilisest isikust ettevõtja: entered in the Business Register, the owner is fully liable.
forms.numbers: registry code, and VAT number if registered

forms.name: Entrepreneur account (ettevõtluskonto)
forms.short: A simplified scheme through a bank account: no legal entity, no VAT registration, tax withheld by the bank.
forms.registrar: the Tax and Customs Board, through the bank

forms.name: General or limited partnership (TÜ / UÜ)
forms.short: Partners trading together; in a limited partnership some partners have limited liability.

forms.name: Private limited company (OÜ)
forms.short: The usual company, also for e-residents; one or more shareholders, share capital from one cent.

forms.name: Public limited company (AS)
forms.short: Shares may be offered to the public; share capital from EUR 25,000.

forms.name: Non-profit association (MTÜ) or foundation (SA)
forms.short: No owners; members or a board.

forms.name: Other or not sure
forms.short: Pick the closest form; your registry card will say. It can be changed later in Company profile.

forms.short: One owner and no separate company.

forms.name: Partnership
forms.short: Two or more owners sharing profit by an agreed ratio.

forms.name: Limited liability partnership
forms.short: Partners with limited liability.

forms.name: Limited liability company (LLC)
forms.short: Owners are members with limited liability.

forms.short: A private company owned by one person.
